instructions: Populate each request from a real selected location; do not invent coordinates.
Specify the feature, view direction and missing property precisely.
Record the capture date and permitted use for every used image.
Image metadata alone is not visual inspection.
A road footprint or OSM layer value is not a physical clearance measurement.
Do not mark both street sides covered if one side is occluded.
Preserve original spelling; record reviewed display changes separately.
Keep unfilled requests and unavailable evidence visible in the release report.
